explication: This repository is a catalog of Module Federation examples, not one application. Its principal demonstrated workflow is a user selecting a remote component in a host, which loads it at runtime and renders it with loading and failure handling. Other examples explore synchronous remote imports, cross-framework and component sharing, routing, and server-side rendering. The graph highlights these product branches and a few concrete internal stages. Evidence is limited to the README and sampled source/index references; unsampled example wiring is not inferred.
